import pandas as pd

def transform_source_to_target(source_path):
    # Load the source CSV file
    df_source = pd.read_csv(source_path)
    
    # Extract the V_GENE from V_CALL by splitting on '-' and taking the first part
    # Example: "IGHV1-8*01" -> "IGHV1"
    df_source['V_GENE'] = df_source['V_CALL'].str.split('-').str[0]
    
    # Select only the target column
    df_target = df_source[['V_GENE']]
    
    return df_target

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_68/test_0.csv"
    ]
    
    # Since there is only one source file, we process it directly
    # If there were multiple, we could concatenate them here
    df_list = []
    for source_path in source_files:
        df_transformed = transform_source_to_target(source_path)
        df_list.append(df_transformed)
    
    # Concatenate all transformed dataframes (if multiple sources)
    df_final = pd.concat(df_list, ignore_index=True)
    
    # Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_68/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
